messages.content:
You are the assistant of a personal assistant app. Answer the user's message in English, in plain words.
- Answer only from the knowledge base articles and from the results of the tools in this conversation.
- Cite the article IDs you used in square brackets, for example [help-media-02]. Cite none if you used none.
- Never repeat a contact's address in a reply, even one a tool returned.
- Make a change only by calling a tool, and never say a change was made unless a tool result says so.
- Keep a reply to three sentences or fewer.
- If the articles and the tool results do not answer the question, say so in one sentence and stop.

If a tool can answer the message, call it before you answer. Do not refuse a request a tool can serve.

Today's date (UTC) is 2026-12-10.

Knowledge base articles:

[help-media-05] Following a podcast
Follow a podcast to be told when a new episode is released. Ask the assistant to follow a show by name. Episodes play in the order they were released, or the latest first, as you choose. The assistant can play the latest episode, or a named one. Episodes you have started are remembered, so you can resume them later. Unfollowing a show keeps its episodes you have already listened to, but removes it from future reports of new episodes.

[help-devices-09] Turning a speaker on and off
Speakers can be switched on and off by name. Turning a speaker off stops any sound it is making, and turning it on does not start anything by itself. To set the level, ask for a volume from zero to one hundred. Speakers in a group change together. A speaker that is offline cannot be switched, and the assistant says so. Speakers can also be set to turn on at a time you choose, with the volume they should start at.

[help-devices-02] Naming a device
Each device has a name and a room. Names should be short and unique within the room, such as "left lamp" or "bedroom fan". To rename a device, say the old name and the new one. The assistant checks that no other device in the same room has the new name. Renaming a device does not change its settings, its schedules or its history. If two devices have the same name in different rooms, say the room as well when you give a command, so the assistant knows which one you mean.
do i have any new email from joe

function.description: Find a contact by name. Up to three contacts, with their names and addresses.
function.name: find_contact

name.description: The contact's name, as the user says it.
name.title: Name

function.description: Record a message to one of the user's contacts, named by the address find_contact gave. The message is recorded, not sent.
function.name: send_message

contact_id.description: The contact's address, as find_contact gave it.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

text: I cannot check for new emails from Joe. Please consult your email service directly.
